notes: Leveling after a rebirth is much faster: each rebirth now boosts XP by +0.7x (rebirth 1 = x1.7, rebirth 5 = x4.5, rebirth 10 = x8) instead of +0.25x, and levels past 25 no longer get steeply more expensive. By rebirth 6 a full climb takes about a third of the fights it used to. Your CPU clone (mirror match and turf defenders) now has exactly your stats and your rebirth unlocks: the finisher, Black Flash and heavy impact frames.
